title: 亞伯達碳幹線 ACTL
summary: ACTL 是二氧化碳輸送與封存基礎設施；課程以多來源質量調和與淨減量邊界研究共同管網。本課依序分析多來源捕集量彙整、共同管網量測調和、單一節點停機影響、接收中斷的虛擬緩衝、腐蝕監測資料界線，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: ACTL is CO2 transport and storage infrastructure; this case studies a shared network through multi-source reconciliation and net-reduction boundaries. The course analyses aggregation of captured mass from sources, meter reconciliation in a shared network, effects of one node outage, hypothetical buffer for receipt interruption, boundaries of corrosion-monitoring evidence, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 多來源捕集量彙整、共同管網量測調和、單一節點停機影響
v31FocusEn: Aggregation of captured mass from sources; Meter reconciliation in a shared network; Effects of one node outage

quiz.question: 關於「多來源捕集量彙整」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Aggregation of captured mass from sources" is correct?
options: 捕集率是來源排放被分離的比例，淨減量還要扣除捕集、壓縮與運輸造成的額外排放。
捕集一噸二氧化碳就必然淨減少一噸排放。
出入口流量只要不同就能立即判定有洩漏。

Capturing one tonne of carbon dioxide necessarily avoids one tonne of emissions.
Any inlet-outlet difference immediately proves a leak.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aggregation of captured mass from sources” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Alberta Carbon Trunk Line”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「多來源捕集量彙整」。ACTL 是二氧化碳輸送與封存基礎設施；課程以多來源質量調和與淨減量邊界研究共同管網。在「亞伯達碳幹線 ACTL」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。捕集率是來源排放被分離的比例，淨減量還要扣除捕集、壓縮與運輸造成的額外排放。邊界若只含一股製程氣，就不能直接聲稱整廠同樣比例減碳；碳信用也不是量測質量的替代品。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Aggregation of captured mass from sources”. ACTL is CO2 transport and storage infrastructure; this case studies a shared network through multi-source reconciliation and net-reduction boundaries. In the teaching model for Alberta Carbon Trunk Line, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Capture rate is the fraction separated from a defined source stream; net reduction must subtract additional emissions from capture, compression and transport. A boundary around one process stream cannot establish the same reduction fraction for an entire site. Credits do not replace a measured mass account. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.explanation: Net = Source capture - Extra；代入 E = 3525 tonne CO2/day source、c = 0.9 fraction captured、X = 250 tonne CO2/day added emissions，得 2,922 tCO2/day（「多來源捕集量彙整」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。

steps.title: 多來源捕集量彙整：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aggregation of captured mass from sources: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多來源捕集量彙整」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Aggregation of captured mass from sources” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Net = Source capture - Extra；代入 E = 3525 tonne CO2/day source、c = 0.9 fraction captured、X = 250 tonne CO2/day added emissions，得 2,922 tCO2/day（「多來源捕集量彙整」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 E 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Net = Source capture - Extra; with E = 3525 tonne CO2/day source, c = 0.9 fraction captured, X = 250 tonne CO2/day added emissions the result is 2,922 tCO2/day (simplified exercise for Aggregation of captured mass from sources; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise E by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：E 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3,240 tCO2/day（+10.9%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising E by 10% changes the result to 3,240 tCO2/day (+10.9%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 2,922 tCO2/day（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 E 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 2,922 tCO2/day (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in E with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: E 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3,240 tCO2/day（+10.9%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising E by 10% changes the result to 3,240 tCO2/day (+10.9%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

For “Aggregation of captured mass from sources”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis.

steps.title: 多來源捕集量彙整：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aggregation of captured mass from sources: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多來源捕集量彙整」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aggregation of captured mass from sources” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「多來源捕集量彙整」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。逐項建立來源排放、捕集量與額外能源排放帳，使用相同時間窗比較，並明確寫出不包含的產品使用階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Aggregation of captured mass from sources”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Build separate accounts for source emissions, captured mass and added energy emissions over matched intervals, explicitly stating whether downstream product use is excluded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 068-01 標記，圖表須寫明「亞伯達碳幹線 ACTL：教學假設」。交付捕集與淨減量兩個數字及共同邊界，所有排放係數列出來源或明示為假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 068-01 and mark charts “Alberta Carbon Trunk Line: teaching assumptions”. Report captured mass and net reduction separately with a shared boundary, citing emission factors or clearly labeling them as assumptions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「多來源捕集量彙整」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Aggregation of captured mass from sources” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: When "Aggregation of captured mass from sources" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。

Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Any inlet-outlet difference immediately proves a leak.

quiz.explanationEn: An error at “Aggregation of captured mass from sources” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 多來源捕集量彙整：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aggregation of captured mass from sources: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多來源捕集量彙整」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「共同管網量測調和」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。時鐘偏移會把正常批次切換看成突發流失；共用校正來源則可能使兩個表同方向偏移，掩蓋真實帳差。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Meter reconciliation in a shared network” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Clock offset can make a normal batch transition look like sudden loss; shared calibration bias can shift both meters together and conceal a genuine discrepancy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
